classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_craft.desc: Your sigil (a tap of J) bursts wider, flies further and comes back sooner, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_imbue.desc: Hold J with a blade in hand: it soaks up your element for two minutes, and its blows carry it. Death takes no imbue, and restoration's blade never holds one.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_ward.desc: Sneak and J lays your sigil on the ground where you look, as a trap: it bursts, harder than a thrown one, under the first foe to step on it. Two lie at once, for a minute each.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_twin.desc: Your Imbue soaks the blade in your off hand as well, one imbue burning in both.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_burst.desc: Hold J on a blade still burning to end the imbue early in a blast round you, as strong as what was left of it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_linger.desc: Your imbues last twice as long.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_etched.desc: While your blade is imbued, every fourth link of a combo throws a sigil off it for nothing.
Your sneak attack on a foe that never knew you were there hits far harder.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_acrobat.d: You climb faster, vault up a block at a run without jumping, fall further unhurt and land softer.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mage_evoker.des: Your blasting spells hit harder, and never hurt your friends, the townsfolk or your beasts.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mage_warder.des: Your wards (Warding, Sanctuary, Bulwark) last half again as long, and Warding soaks more.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_hunter.d: More harm to your favoured foe, and you read its trail half again as far.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_beasts.d: Sneak and press J looking at a beast you tamed: it becomes your companion, and grows with your Ranger level, tougher, harder-biting and a little bigger. One at a time.
